_comment: Two-fixture oracle, fixture B (spec 107 T067). Identical to fixture_a.json except mcpServers drops `b` and `a__b`, and access.group_servers.ops drops the now-nonexistent `b`. Every other byte — users, groups, access.group_servers.eng, default_servers, the ops-only profile, admin_emails — is unchanged, so any behavioural difference an entitled caller (e.g. Alice, group eng, entitled only to `a` in both fixtures) sees between A and B can only come from server EXISTENCE, never from a different grant. See fixture_oracle_test.go's assertTwoFixture for how this parity is enforced in Go.

profiles.name: ops-only
profiles._note: b does not exist in this fixture; config.ValidateProfiles warn-skips the reference (EffectiveServers returns []), it does not fail to load.
